messages.subject: Plotting marginal and conditional occupancy
parts:
Dear all

 I am currently using MSOM following Rota et al 2016. I came up with some results and want to illustrate my results using ggplot and I am ok with all the results I have got. However, when I am trying to plot the marginal and conditional occupancy I got an error message saying:

                                Error in data.frame(GG = rep(nd_cond$Gazelle), occupancy = c(Leop_Hyaena_1$Predicted,  : 
                                 arguments imply differing number of rows: 100, 72, 200 
I tried to play with the numbers but still I wasn't able to fix the problem. So your help with this is very much appreciated.

Below the codes I runned to get the above result 

> nd_cond_GG <- data.frame(habitat = rep(mean(site.covs$Dense_habitat), 100),
+                          Bush = rep(mean(site.covs$Bush_Duiker), 100),
+                          Or = rep(mean(site.covs$Oribi), 100),
+                          Babbon = rep(mean(site.covs$Olive_Babbon), 100),
+                          dikdik = rep(mean(site.covs$Gunther_dikdik), 100),
+                          Klip = rep(mean(site.covs$Klipspringer), 100),
+                          Bush = rep(mean(site.covs$Bushback), 100),
+                          Gazelle = seq(min(site.covs$ Grant_Gazelle), 
+                             max(site.covs$Grant_Gazelle), length.out = 100))
> 

> Leop_Hyaena_1 <- predict(M6, type = 'state', species = 'Leopard',
+                             cond = 'SH', newdata = nd_cond_GG)
Bootstrapping confidence intervals with 100 samples

> Leop_Hyaena_0 <- predict(M6, type = 'state', species = 'Leopard',
+                             cond = '-SH', newdata = nd_cond_GG)
Bootstrapping confidence intervals with 100 samples

> gg_df_cond_GG <- data.frame(
+                  GG = rep(nd_cond_GG$Gazelle),
+                  occupancy = c(Leop_Hyaena_1$Predicted,
+                  Leop_Hyaena_0$Predicted),
+                  low = c(Leop_Hyaena_1$lower,
+                  Leop_Hyaena_0$lower),
+                  high = c(Leop_Hyaena_1$upper,
+                  Leop_Hyaena_0$upper),
+                  conditional = rep(c('SH present',
+                                       'SH absent'), each = 100))

Error in data.frame(GG = rep(nd_cond_GG$Gazelle), occupancy = c(Leop_Hyaena_1$Predicted,  : 
                                 arguments imply differing number of rows: 100, 72, 200 

So I am hereby, asking you to help me to fix this problem please. 

Faithfully yours
